changelog: Sales lead page: the contact card shows the account's primary contact (name, position, e-mail, phone) instead of the lead row's `@import.local` stand-in address, and the record's rep corrects it in place through `PATCH /api/sales/leads/[id]/contact` — the account's contact columns and the lead's name and phone in one transaction, never the login address, audited by field name, sending nothing (#3655).

en: Lead page: the contact now shows the real person on the account, and you can correct the name, position, e-mail and phone right there.
tr: Müşteri adayı sayfası: iletişim kartı artık hesaptaki gerçek kişiyi gösteriyor; ad, pozisyon, e-posta ve telefonu doğrudan buradan düzeltebilirsiniz.
de: Lead-Seite: Der Kontakt zeigt jetzt die echte Person beim Account, und Name, Position, E-Mail und Telefon lassen sich direkt dort korrigieren.
